concepts.subject: Diverse Team Meeting Room
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a well-lit, modern conference room with a diverse group of 5 professionals seated around a wooden table, warm color palette, upbeat mood, slight low-angle shot, with a cityscape outside the window, neutral background, and a mix of laptops and notepads on the table.
concepts.title: Diverse Team Collaborating In Office
concepts.description: A group of diverse business professionals sitting around a conference table, engaged in a meeting, with laptops and notepads, in a modern office setting with a city view.

concepts.subject: Person Meditating Outdoors
concepts.image_prompt: Create a serene, outdoor scene with a single person meditating on a rocky coast, warm golden lighting, peaceful mood, with a slight high-angle shot, and a vast ocean landscape in the background, minimal composition, and a natural color palette.
concepts.title: Person Meditating By The Ocean
concepts.description: A person sitting in a meditative pose on a rocky coastline, with the ocean stretching out to the horizon, surrounded by natural scenery, in a peaceful and serene atmosphere.

concepts.subject: Fresh Fruit Salad Bowl
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a vibrant, colorful still-life image of a large bowl filled with a variety of fresh fruits, such as strawberries, blueberries, grapes, and pineapple, with a clean and simple background, natural lighting, and a slightly overhead shot, highlighting the textures and colors of the fruits.
concepts.title: Fresh Fruit Salad In A Bowl
concepts.description: A large bowl filled with a colorful and fresh mix of fruits, including strawberries, blueberries, grapes, and pineapple, on a simple and clean background, showcasing the variety and vibrant colors of the fruits.

concepts.subject: Person Working On Laptop
concepts.image_prompt: Create a modern, minimalist image of a person sitting at a desk, working on a laptop, with a neutral background, soft natural lighting, and a slight eye-level shot, focusing on the person's hands and the laptop screen, with a few office supplies and a cup of coffee nearby.
concepts.title: Person Working On Laptop At Desk
concepts.description: A person sitting at a desk, working on a laptop, surrounded by a few office supplies and a cup of coffee, in a modern and minimalist setting, with a focus on the person's hands and the laptop screen.

concepts.subject: Beautiful Mountain Landscape
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a breathtaking, panoramic image of a majestic mountain range, with snow-capped peaks, lush green forests, and a serene lake in the foreground, during a sunny day with a few clouds, and a wide-angle shot, capturing the vastness and beauty of the landscape.
concepts.title: Majestic Mountain Range Landscape
concepts.description: A panoramic view of a majestic mountain range, with snow-capped peaks, lush green forests, and a serene lake in the foreground, under a sunny sky with a few clouds, showcasing the natural beauty and grandeur of the landscape.

concepts.subject: Diverse Group Of Friends
concepts.image_prompt: Create a lively, outdoor image of a diverse group of friends from different ethnicities, ages, and abilities, gathered together, laughing and chatting, with a warm and sunny lighting, and a slight low-angle shot, highlighting the joy and camaraderie of the group.
concepts.title: Diverse Group Of Friends Having Fun
concepts.description: A diverse group of friends from different ethnicities, ages, and abilities, gathered together outdoors, laughing and chatting, in a joyful and inclusive atmosphere, showcasing the beauty of diversity and friendship.

concepts.subject: Woman Practicing Yoga
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a serene, indoor image of a woman practicing yoga, in a peaceful and minimalistic setting, with a neutral background, soft natural lighting, and a slight eye-level shot, focusing on the woman's pose and expression, with a few yoga props nearby.
concepts.title: Woman Practicing Yoga In Studio
concepts.description: A woman practicing yoga in a peaceful and minimalistic indoor setting, surrounded by a few yoga props, with a focus on her pose and expression, in a serene and calming atmosphere.

concepts.subject: Person Working From Coffee Shop
concepts.image_prompt: Create a modern, bustling image of a person working on a laptop, sitting at a small table in a coffee shop, with a blurred background of people and coffee cups, and a slight eye-level shot, focusing on the person's hands and the laptop screen, with a few coffee cups and pastry boxes nearby.
concepts.title: Person Working From Coffee Shop
concepts.description: A person sitting at a small table in a coffee shop, working on a laptop, surrounded by a few coffee cups and pastry boxes, in a modern and bustling atmosphere, with a blurred background of people and coffee shop activity.

concepts.subject: Modern Office Workspace
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a modern, minimalist image of a shared office workspace, with a few desks, chairs, and laptops, and a large window with a city view, during a sunny day, with a slight overhead shot, and a focus on the clean lines, minimal decor, and natural lighting.
concepts.title: Modern Shared Office Workspace
concepts.description: A modern and minimalist shared office workspace, with a few desks, chairs, and laptops, and a large window with a city view, in a clean and clutter-free environment, with a focus on natural lighting and minimal decor.

concepts.subject: Smart Home Devices
concepts.image_prompt: Create a modern, sleek image of a smart home setup, with a few devices such as a smart thermostat, smart speaker, and smart light bulbs, on a clean and minimalist background, with a slight overhead shot, and a focus on the devices' screens and interfaces.
concepts.title: Smart Home Devices And Technology
concepts.description: A collection of smart home devices, including a smart thermostat, smart speaker, and smart light bulbs, on a clean and minimalist background, showcasing the latest smart home technology and innovations.
